shadows.name: prototype-switcher
shadows.purpose: Keep development controls separate from the evaluated layout.

components.name: Source selection
components.description: A source in the notebook margin.
components.css: .ds-source { text-align:left; background:#dbe6f4; border:none; border-radius:7px; padding:.85rem .6rem; color:#202d3d; font:600 16px Source Sans 3,sans-serif; } .ds-source span { display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:400; margin-top:.4rem; } .ds-source:hover { background:#e0e7ef; } .ds-source:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2356a5; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Review label
components.description: Written review state near the citation.
components.css: .ds-status { color:#284e81; background:#eaf1fc; border-radius:4px; padding:.2rem .5rem; font:13px Source Sans 3,sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: A library margin beside an open note
narrative.overview: Private research notes remain readable while their source, generated analysis, and human commentary remain distinguishable.
donts: Do not promote synthetic examples into production.
